Alex Baena.note: Watch Baena for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Alex Baena.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Alex Grimaldo.note: Grimaldo's signature is delivering the ball without needing much space. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Alex Grimaldo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Aymeric Laporte.note: Laporte's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Aymeric Laporte.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Borja Iglesias.note: Iglesias's signature is the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Borja Iglesias.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在耐心判断点球手最后一下动作上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Dani Olmo.note: Olmo's signature is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Dani Olmo.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

David Raya.note: Watch Raya for turning a save into the first pass of an attack. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line.
David Raya.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是把一次扑救变成进攻第一传。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会直塞球越过后防时及时出击。

Eric Garcia.summary: Eric García is a Spain centre-back from Barcelona who gives the national team build-up passing, tactical coverage, and calm defending.
Eric Garcia.note: García stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Eric Garcia.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Fabian Ruiz.note: Ruiz's edge is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Fabian Ruiz.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ferran Torres.note: Watch Torres for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ferran Torres.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Gavi.note: Gavi's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Gavi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Joan Garcia.note: García is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Joan Garcia.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Lamine Yamal.note: Yamal's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Lamine Yamal.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Marc Cucurella.note: Cucurella is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Marc Cucurella.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Marc Pubill.note: Pubill's signature is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Marc Pubill.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Marcos Llorente.note: Llorente's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Marcos Llorente.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Martin Zubimendi.note: Zubimendi's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Martin Zubimendi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Mikel Merino.note: Merino is defined by reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mikel Merino.noteZh: 他靠在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mikel Oyarzabal.note: Watch Oyarzabal for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift.
Mikel Oyarzabal.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。留意他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Nico Williams.note: Williams is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Nico Williams.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Pau Cubarsi.note: Watch Cubarsí for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Pau Cubarsi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Pedri.note: Pedri stands out for receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Pedri.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Pedro Porro.note: Porro is defined by delivering the ball without needing much space. He uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Pedro Porro.noteZh: 他靠在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力与同位置球员拉开差异。他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Rodri.note: Watch Rodri for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Rodri.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Unai Simon.note: Simón is defined by starting high enough to protect the space behind his defense. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Unai Simon.noteZh: 他靠用靠前站位保护后防身后空间与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Victor Munoz.note: Muñoz stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Victor Munoz.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Yeremy Pino.note: Pino's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Yeremy Pino.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。
